style: simple rounded bear picture-book, sparse outlined flat-shape terrain

files.notes: Portrait home terrain. Spacious open ground and branching cream paths. No baked buildings or bears.
Each world has six large empty zones for separate landmark overlays. Settlement river/roads, industrial canal/rail, stellar linked islands. No landmark buildings or characters.

Very thin generated vertical separation lines at panel edges. When cropping for integration, trim 1-2 pixels at interior vertical boundaries. Sparse edge trees and open centers. No bears, buildings or UI.

qa.minorDeviation: A subtle smooth color wash remains despite flat-color instruction; no granular painterly texture.
